metadata.location: Fortich Street, Poblacion, Valencia City, Bukidnon, Philippines
metadata.source_poster: User-provided CHO services poster; right-hand Annex column only
notes: Only services listed under the CHO Annex column were transcribed, plus the subsequently announced TB-DOTS transfer.
Poster schedules are transcribed as printed and have not been independently confirmed as current.
The TB-DOTS Center transfer to the Annex was announced effective October 26, 2026.
Most poster entries give days only, not service hours. Listed days do not guarantee walk-in availability.
Confirm schedules, requirements, fees and service locations with CHO before presenting this as an official current directory.
